Test language detection from shebang line via bytes input

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="text/x-source-code", uri="https://example.com/code/script.sh")
    result = await extract(input)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
